messages:
alex: heads-up: ACME reported an invoice spike Sat ~03:20 UTC — billed tokens ~18k higher than served for model rdx-3b-cont. request ids r-90a / r-90b. suspect continuous-batcher + KV-prefetch warmup.
maria: can you drop a quick sample request + which route/plan? any deploys around then?
alex: sample pattern: short prompt repeated in bursts (user sent 200 rapid similar requests). dashboard served_tokens ~42k vs invoice billed ~60k. Dedicated pool, cont-batcher enabled on route.
jordan: quick note: billing counts tokens sent to the runtime (includes prefetch/cache-fill tokens). console "served tokens" is tokens returned to caller. That mismatch often comes from prefetch or warmup writes being metered.
sam: paging @billing-bot for attribution: please confirm whether prefetch/cache-fill tokens are included in billed line items for acct=acme-123 and r-90a/r-90b. also any batcher rollouts in last 48h?
billing-bot: billing: confirmed. Invoice line for acct=acme-123 on 2026-03-14 shows model=rdx-3b-cont billed_tokens=60000 source=runtime_v2. Prefetch/cache fill tokens are included in runtime metering. No special bill credits applied.
maria: ok — why do console metrics drop those tokens then? customers read console and see fewer tokens than invoice, confusing them.
jordan: console "served_tokens" is intentionally post-routing/response. We currently do not surface "runtime_sent_tokens" (includes prefetch). Traces show prefetch fills in this incident. Example lines from runtime trace: 
```
[runtime] request_id=r-90a mode=continuous batch_size=3 prefetch=enabled prefetch_tokens=12000 served_tokens=42000 billed_tokens=54000
[cache] kv_hit=false fill_tokens=12000 evicted_prefix=none
```
This pattern -> billed includes the 12k prefetch tokens.
alex: repro steps I ran locally: hammer same short prompt at 30ms intervals for 5 minutes against the dedicated route with cont_batcher toggled on. curl snippet: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"model":"rdx-3b-cont","input":"Summarize: ...","continuous":true}'
```
maria: thanks. ops question: can we turn off cont-batcher for this customer as a quick mitigation?
sam: yes we can toggle per-route. I'll disable cont-batcher for acme-123 and monitor. also opening support ticket to propose a credit for the delta while we investigate.
jordan: product action: we should add a console metric for "prefetch_metered_tokens" and label invoice lines clearer. I'll draft a brief PRD.
billing-bot: billing: created invoice note id=inv-note-452 referencing runtime_v2 prefetch attribution.
maria: @alex can you paste full trace ids (r-90a/b plus traces) so eng-sre can pull logs?
alex: trace ids: t-777, t-778, t-779. attaching short export in support ticket.
sam: created support ticket #SUP-2249 and tagged finance + eng-sre. I'll post status updates there.
alex: thanks all. customer asks for quick one-off credit if delta > 5%. I'll ping AMs. :pray:
maria: noted — follow-up: add runbook note: "billing vs served discrepancy — check runtime_sent_tokens, prefetch fills, cont-batcher warmup".
jordan: closing loop: short-term mitigations=disable cont-batcher on route, offer credit, add invoice note. longer-term=console metric + improved invoice labeling.
sam: on it. :white_check_mark:
